probes.text: Arya shares a fireside meal and drink with a group of young Lannister soldiers in the Riverlands.
Edd opens the gate at Castle Black to receive Bran and Meera, arrived out of the snow.
In Winterfell's hall, Sansa contradicts Jon in front of everyone over the young Umber and Karstark heirs.
At a roadside inn, Arya is served stew by an old friend from her travels who bakes bread.
Cersei receives a banker from Braavos and assures him the crown's enormous debt will soon be repaid in full.
Littlefinger presents Bran with a slim Valyrian steel dagger with a dragonbone hilt as a gift.
Jorah arrives at Dragonstone and presents himself once more before Daenerys, fully recovered.
The rival camps gather for a parley in a ruined pit on the edge of King's Landing.
On the shore at Dragonstone, Theon stands before the last of his ironborn men.
